convert_md_to_mdx: convert a markdown document to Svelte-compatible MDX format with component imports and page metadata
process_md: process markdown text by converting includes, cleaning doctest syntax, fixing image links, and stripping .md extensions from internal links
clean_runnable_blocks: clean runnable Python code blocks by removing doc-builder hide directives and warning on bare assert statements
convert_literalinclude: convert literalinclude directives into markdown code blocks by reading and embedding file contents
convert_include: convert include directives into plain markdown blocks by reading and embedding file contents
